protocol.purpose: Observed incidence of negative radial curvature near the rational Stokes fold after shared-MLP fitting of analyzer observations
protocol.activation: SiLU; softplus intensity + 1e-6; rational folded polarization
protocol.diagnostic_precision: float64 at stored float32 head coordinates
protocol.candidate_definition: abs(r-1)<=threshold and radial_curvature/I**2 < -1e-7; candidate is not a proven stationary saddle
protocol.stationarity_definition: norm([dL/da,dL/dw])/max(I**2,1e-12)<=1e-5 per unaveraged pixel loss; not backbone stationarity
protocol.perturbation_space: independent output head coordinates; shared network fixed
protocol.exact_fold_test: normalize final candidate w to unit radius, solve intensity directional stationarity for same quadratic, compute exact-fold curvature and support-halfspace bound; distinguish transported construction from trained point
protocol.positive_control: target-informed exact aligned stationary fold; calibration W=diag(1,.5,.5)
protocol.stop: all20 fixed runs completed or 1200 seconds; no expanded seed or initialization search based on outcomes
protocol.weak_signal: positive near-fold negative-curvature incidence under unmodified trained coordinates
protocol.kill_condition: no additional training searches if incidence is absent or transient; report thresholds and retained predictions
remaining_assets: float32 final predictions and head coordinates

positive_control_escape.start: exact stationary fold vs same fold with radial offset 0.01; independent head coordinates
positive_control_escape.purpose: detector and escape control; not an incidence sample
